answers.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN period_end = '2024-12-31' AND category = 'Total transaction revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period_end = '2023-12-31' AND category = 'Total transaction revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN period_end = '2023-12-31' AND category = 'Total transaction revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 AS value FROM revenues;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN period_end = '2024-12-31' AND channel = 'Total Trading Volume' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period_end = '2023-12-31' AND channel = 'Total Trading Volume' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN period_end = '2023-12-31' AND channel = 'Total Trading Volume' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 AS value FROM spot_volume;

SELECT (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND category = 'Total transaction revenue') / (SELECT amount FROM spot_volume WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND channel = 'Total Trading Volume') / 1e6 * 100.0 AS value;

SELECT ((SELECT r24.amount FROM revenues r24 WHERE r24.period_end = '2024-12-31' AND r24.category = 'Total transaction revenue') / (SELECT sv24.amount FROM spot_volume sv24 WHERE sv24.period_end = '2024-12-31' AND sv24.channel = 'Total Trading Volume') / 1e6 - (SELECT r23.amount FROM revenues r23 WHERE r23.period_end = '2023-12-31' AND r23.category = 'Total transaction revenue') / (SELECT sv23.amount FROM spot_volume sv23 WHERE sv23.period_end = '2023-12-31' AND sv23.channel = 'Total Trading Volume') / 1e6) * 10000.0 AS value;
